newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: Namibia shortlists eight firms for powerline tender.
newsitem.headline: Namibia shortlists eight firms for powerline tender.

text.p: The Namibian power utility Nampower has shortlisted eight international companies for the tender to build a 400kV power line from the Orange River on the South African border to the Namibian capital Windhoek.
In a statement issued on Friday, the company said the evaluation of pre-qualification documents had already been completed.
"Tenders for transmission line work will be issued in July 1997", it said, "and the contract awarded by early December 1997."
It did not name the eight shortlisted companies.

The 90-day contracts for route clearing and servitude gates on the 720 km interconnector, it said, had been awarded to three Namibian entrepreneurs to "contribute to the empowerment of previously disadvantaged Namibians".
